Holiday Schedules Advisory Groups Home About the Federal Reserve Banks and Our Services Holiday Schedules Holiday Schedules The following are the standard holiday schedules for FedCash® Services and FedACH® Services. The International Holiday Schedule provides foreign country banking holidays that may impact FedGlobal® ACH Payments processing. For a list of foreign country bank holidays, please visit Office Holidays (Off-site). Please see the FedGlobal ACH Payments Service Origination Manual (PDF) for processing and settlement information related to foreign country holidays. Supplementary holiday schedules for participating countries may be found in the appropriate section of the manual. For additional questions regarding holiday processing, please contact customer support.
